GLD.research_context: Safe-haven proxy within fiscal-dominance regime; likely to benefit if Treasury term-premium spikes reignite gold bid, especially if Fed remains on hold while deficits >6%-of-GDP pressure real yields lower.

TLT.research_context: Direct exposure to term-premium shock thesis—elevated Treasury supply minus Fed & foreign bid sets up asymmetric rally on any growth scare or QT-pause headline; high negative equity correlation flags it as macro hedge.

SPY.research_context: Index at center of volatility-regime hypothesis—dealer gamma overlays suppress realized vol while fiscal dominance, rate convexity and yen-carry unwind create latent left-tail; concentration risk in mega-caps amplifies shock transmission.

QQQ.research_context: Highest concentration exposure to mega-cap tech that currently caps index vol; if macro shock flips rate-equity correlation negative, QQQ's duration-sensitive growth multiples make it the fastest leg lower in an asymmetric volatility shift.
